text:
No option can be put forward from this run because it did not test your churn requirement.

- The comparison is robust under the changes tested, but “monthly churn < 4%” could not be scored against the model’s churn output; its measurement frame is unknown.
- The goal was also ranked as “higher MRR is better” without an explicitly stated goal direction, and the £20k/month threshold could not be evaluated in the analysis samples’ frame.
- The most sensitive model input is the Pro subscriber base, an Olumi-inferred estimate; new Pro sign-ups and monthly churn are also Olumi estimates. The analysis therefore remains provisional.

The key unresolved reasoning step is to specify what the 4% churn limit means in the same terms as the model measures it.
